entities.name: Herpes zoster
observations: Unilateral painful dermatomal eruption preceded by burning pain is characteristic; antiviral benefit is greatest when treatment begins early and is limited once lesions are crusted.

entities.name: Zoster HIV screen
observations: In an otherwise healthy adult younger than 50 with zoster, consider HIV testing; here late crusted lesions make HIV screening more appropriate than starting antiviral therapy.

entities.name: PMID:27501780
observations: Chachi et al., 2017: PP5-dependent impairment of glucocorticoid receptor function contributes to corticosteroid insensitivity in airway smooth muscle in severe asthma.

entities.name: PPP5C (PP5)
observations: Protein phosphatase 5 was increased in ASM cells from severe asthmatics; PP5 siRNA restored fluticasone repression of chemokine production, GRα nuclear translocation, and GRE-dependent GILZ expression in vitro.

entities.name: PP5 ASM steroid insensitivity
observations: In patient-derived ASM, TNF-α-induced CCL11/CCL5 were less responsive to fluticasone and dexamethasone in severe asthma; PP5 knockdown restored fluticasone responsiveness and GRα signaling.
PP5 expression was increased in ASM bundles in severe-asthma endobronchial biopsies; the intervention rescue was performed in vitro.
